world 1 (key hamstrung).reader_note: Key rests on combining the broken joint rate with papers retreating to purely city coverage; 'hamstrung' (papers shrank to eight pages) remains a close second, and 'dethroned' is half-supported by advertisers leaving.

world 2 (key homogenized).reader_note: 'A reader ... in any city met the same names' hands over homogenized in one sentence; fractured is struck as the opposite end of the pair, and radio reading the papers' stories only after publication weakens dethroned.

world 3 (key fractured).reader_note: Larger papers voted to sell and left for a new service while the rest refused: fractured; 'both groups' circulation kept rising' kills dethroned and hamstrung, and the split itself kills homogenized.

world 0 (key dethroned).reader_note: Radio reached listeners a day ahead (papers lost first place for news) while circulation kept rising, which kills hamstrung; homogenized partly fits the shared wire service, but that predates radio; dethroned depends on combining both sentences.

world 3 (key estate).reader_note: One family owns every palm and well and ships the dates out, so 'estate'; 'could buy nothing there' kills emporium and fairground.

world 0 (key emporium).reader_note: Year-round shops buying from one caravan and selling to the next decide emporium; 'all year' weakens fairground, gatehouse and estate lack support.

world 1 (key fairground).reader_note: A month each spring of 'trading, racing and weddings' then scattering, quiet the other eleven months, gives fairground; trading makes emporium a literal near-fit but misses racing, weddings and seasonality; a few families growing their own dates undercuts estate.

world 2 (key gatehouse).reader_note: Fort over the only water, a tenth taken from every load, enemies turned back: a controlled point of passage. 'The rest of each load went on to the coast unopened' kills emporium and fairground; estate is weak.

world 2 (key domesticated).reader_note: The relocation sentence (capital to market town, camel to mule) decides 'domesticated'; 'all eleven episodes remained... as long' kills distilled and honed.

world 3 (key fused).reader_note: Merchant's son merged into the saint's boy with episodes alternating decides fused; 'still set in the desert capital' kills domesticated, and twice the length plus disputed order kill distilled and honed.

world 0 (key distilled).reader_note: Forty pages reduced to one three-minute episode gives distilled; 'still set in the desert capital' kills domesticated, 'kept a single episode' kills fused, and 'in nearly the words of the 1650 text' kills honed.

world 1 (key honed).reader_note: Kept all eleven episodes and the same telling length kills distilled, kept the desert capital kills domesticated; rising tricks, a rhyme and the surprise moved to the end make honed, while fused is weak.

world 0 (key highway).reader_note: Hatchery is off the passage's topic (no breeding mentioned). Uncrossable chute plus animals on the log every night and the worn moss strip give highway; hostel/garden are thin.

world 1 (key hatchery).reader_note: 'Salmon dig their nests in that bar, and the young stay in the gravel' nearly states hatchery; hostel is the near-miss, highway dies to deer wading below rather than crossing on the log.

world 2 (key garden).reader_note: Seedlings in 'a dense row along its whole length' give garden; hostel (lodging for travellers) is off-topic for a passage about plants and falls on a surface read; the log spanning the stream makes highway a literal fit, and hatchery is the nursery lure but applies to eggs and animals.

world 3 (key hostel).reader_note: 'Each staying a few days before going on' practically defines hostel; hatchery is the near-miss, ruled out because spawning happens on gravel beds miles above; garden falls on a surface read (off-register for a log in a salmon run).

world 1 (key doomed).reader_note: Barred from new members, union dies out by attrition: doomed. Let stand kills disbanded, won strikes kill defanged, struck together kills divided.

world 2 (key defanged).reader_note: Each distractor dies to one planted phrase: 'let the union stand' and growth to nine thousand kill disbanded and doomed, 'voted almost to a man' kills divided; 'never again stopped work' plus 'in effect' hands over defanged.

world 3 (key divided).reader_note: Operators 'formed their own association' and 'Both bodies still bargained there in 1944' give divided and kill doomed/disbanded; the laborers winning a nine-week strike kills defanged.

world 0 (key disbanded).reader_note: 'Without dissent' rules out divided and the union never meeting again until 1919 rules out defanged (weakened but still alive); doomed is the near-miss but describes a future end, while the fund repayment, hall sale and vote to comply ended it at once.

world 0 (key drained).reader_note: Population steady but workers and shopping went south and stores closed: drained. The road on the riverbank below town kills fragmented; fossilized and engulfed fit parts of the passage.

world 1 (key fragmented).reader_note: 'Raised on a bank through the middle of the town, between the mill and the streets' nearly states fragmented; population held at eight thousand kills drained and engulfed, and the new grocery/school/fire company kills fossilized.

world 2 (key engulfed).reader_note: Road 'below the town, on land the railroad had abandoned' kills fragmented, growth to 26,000 kills drained, city offices and chains kill fossilized; no open field from the city gives engulfed.

world 3 (key fossilized).reader_note: The same population, the same families running the stores and a newest building from 1951 decide fossilized; drained is killed by the steady population, engulfed and fragmented by the road running on the far bank with its exit nine miles off.

world 2 (key depot).reader_note: Coal warehouses that steamships call at every voyage: depot. Shelled without reply kills fortress, sailing ships passing by undercuts haven.

world 3 (key fortress).reader_note: Fortress fits barracks and a garrison holding out months, but fleets sailing past to burn the cities means it never protected them, and depot is equally defensible from the twice-stressed warehouses of powder and grain. Not exclusive.

world 0 (key gateway).reader_note: Every ship cleared customs and took an island pilot through the only channel, so the island controlled entry; warehouses make depot a literal fit, killed by 'that same day ... fully reloaded'; fortress and haven unsupported.

world 1 (key haven).reader_note: The warehouses literally fit depot, but ships came in only when gales blew and passed by in calm weather, which makes the island a refuge; gateway is weakened by ships passing on either side.

world 0 (key headquarters).reader_note: Standing committee, files in the safe, couriers dispatched decide headquarters; hub is weakened by 'no other exile was let into the room', hothouse by leaders unchanged since before the war, embassy has no representative function.

world 1 (key hothouse).reader_note: Committee 'sat in another country' kills headquarters and reporters handed its address kills embassy; the poet training new arrivals who later edited all the papers gives hothouse, while exiles gathering there makes hub a literal near-fit.

world 2 (key hub).reader_note: Members of all three parties came and news passed from table to table, which decides hub; offices elsewhere kill headquarters, reporters going to those offices kill embassy, and hothouse is a plausible near-miss.
